note: SUPERSEDED BY THE B189 PLAYTEST -- THE FIX DESCRIBED BELOW DID NOT WORK. The owner playtested this very build and the villager was STILL lying across the spa lounger. The root cause named below (the orientation selector) and the fix named below (NE -> NW) are BOTH wrong for the receiving pose, which needs a HORIZONTAL MIRROR of whatever the selector picks. Both placements were therefore wrong together, and no choice of arm could have fixed it. The handle gate described below IS still correct and still in place. See issue #330 and the B190 notes. The original note follows, kept rather than deleted (AGENTS.md 11). === Patcher matrix for B189. BUILT FROM main AT 3a598d2, which is PR #348 squash-merged. The build ran from the pre-merge branch commit d0d1fd7, and an earlier version of this note recorded that hash. Review correctly flagged it: d0d1fd7 was squashed away by the merge and does not resolve in the published repository, so it documented a checkout an auditor cannot obtain, while docs/B189-release-notes.md recorded 3a598d2. THE BUILD CHECKOUT IS PRESERVED UNDER A DURABLE REF, so the equivalence is COMPARED rather than asserted. This took three review rounds to get right, and each earlier attempt failed the same way -- recording provenance an auditor could not check. First the config cited d0d1fd7, which the squash merge of #348 made unresolvable. Then it cited the generator blob plus a claim about the rest of the tree, which still required trust. Then it cited the tree id of 3a598d2 alone, which proves what the MERGED revision contains but not what the BUILD CHECKOUT contained, leaving the only link a mutable branch that may be deleted. The build checkout is now the annotated tag b189-build-checkout. An auditor runs `git rev-parse b189-build-checkout^{tree}` and `git rev-parse 3a598d2^{tree}`; both print ca7338d233fe0cf3044c0c11bfc8edf4a4729ff0, which compares the two trees directly. Verified from a fresh shallow clone rather than a working copy that still held the squashed commit -- checking from the wrong vantage point is how the first two attempts looked correct. The superseded hash is kept rather than deleted (AGENTS.md 11). B189 exists for ONE player-reported defect: the spa lounger orientation (#330). The owner playtested the published B188 patcher and reported 7 of 8 items GOOD in actual play -- exercise bike drop labels, treadmill targeting, bike autonomous selection, ping-pong, home gym drop-in-place, yoga, and the patio drinks position -- with one lounger correct and one wrong. ROOT CAUSE: VF2FurnitureFacesNorthWest tested `orientation == 3`. The owner confirmed a lounger only ever occupies TWO orientations and a live capture showed those are 0 and 1, so `== 3` never matched a real lounger and BOTH placements took the northeast arm. Orientation 0 wants northeast so it looked right by luck; orientation 1 wants northwest and was the broken one. THE FIX IS GATED, and that gating is the substance of it. Codex review caught that the reclined-pose branch `if (info.orientation == 1 || VF2SpaLoungerHasHandle(...))` admits ordinary and mobile Lounge Chairs at orientation 1 despite its own comment claiming to be spa-scoped, so changing the shared predicate would have regressed loungers the owner had already confirmed working. The spa rule now lives in VF2SpaLoungerFacesNorthWest, which returns false unless the handle is a spa lounger; the shared predicate is restored to `orientation == 3` for chaises and the hammock. A truth table over every combination that can reach that branch shows EXACTLY ONE REACHABLE ROW CHANGES: orientation 1 on a spa lounger, NE -> NW. Ordinary Lounge Chairs at orientation 1 are byte-identical. SEEDED FROM B188, NOT AN OLDER RELEASE. VF2 builds inherit ASSETS from the seed, so a seed predating B188 would silently drop the Exercise Bike (0x99) and Ping-Pong Table (0x9a) content maps that B188 added, and the build would still report success. All 32 B188 seed directories were confirmed present before this file was written. Seeds supply assets ONLY: every overlay is rebuilt from the current generator and must be verified individually, because nothing in the release path inspects overlay bytes. Export with work/export_release_bundle.py, NEVER work/export_offline_patch_bundle.py directly -- B183 shipped twelve features short precisely because the low-level exporter was called directly and the wrapper's guards never ran. NOT PLAYTESTED AT THE TIME OF THIS BUILD. The lounger fix has static evidence only: 115 tests across four lounger/orientation suites, five independent mutations caught, and the emitted C++ compiles. Issue #330 stays open until the owner confirms both loungers in play on this artifact.
